entries.title: Noetherian ring: definition and ACC equivalence
entries.statement: A ring R is Noetherian if any ideal of R is finitely generated. This is equivalent to the ascending chain condition (ACC) for ideals of R.
entries.keywords: noetherian ring definition ideal finitely generated ascending chain condition acc equivalent stabilizes

entries.title: Hilbert basis theorem: finitely generated rings over a Noetherian ring
entries.statement: Any finitely generated ring over a Noetherian ring is Noetherian; any localization of a Noetherian ring is Noetherian. The proof reduces to showing that if R is Noetherian then R[X] is Noetherian, via the ideals of leading coefficients of an ascending chain.
entries.keywords: hilbert basis theorem polynomial ring noetherian leading coefficient ideal ascending chain stabilizes finitely generated algebra quotient localization

entries.title: Finite type algebra over a field or Z is Noetherian
entries.statement: Any finite type algebra over a field is Noetherian. Any finite type algebra over the integers Z is Noetherian.
entries.keywords: finite type algebra field integers noetherian polynomial ring variables finitely generated

entries.title: Finite modules over a Noetherian ring are finitely presented
entries.statement: Let R be a Noetherian ring. Any finite R-module is of finite presentation; any submodule of a finite module is finite; any finite type R-algebra is of finite presentation.
entries.keywords: noetherian finite module submodule finite presentation finite type algebra

entries.title: Spectrum of a Noetherian ring is a Noetherian space
entries.statement: If R is a Noetherian ring then Spec(R) is a Noetherian topological space.
entries.keywords: noetherian ring spectrum spec topological space

entries.title: A Noetherian ring has finitely many minimal primes
entries.statement: If R is a Noetherian ring then Spec(R) has finitely many irreducible components; equivalently R has finitely many minimal primes.
entries.keywords: noetherian ring minimal primes irreducible components finitely many spectrum
